value.basis_publication: Extension and Revision of the von Baeyer system for naming polycyclic compounds (including bicyclic compounds) (IUPAC Recommendations 1999)
supersedes: Rules A-31, A-32, and B-14 in the 1979 Recommendations (ref. 1)

semantic_units.term: scope of the saturated von Baeyer system

value.definition: a skeletal atom of the ring system bonded to three or more skeletal atoms

value.selection: the ring system including as many skeletal atoms of the polycyclic system as possible

value.bicyclic_system: the bridge included in the bicyclic system

value.membership: both are included in the main ring

value.definition: a bridge not included in the main ring or the main bridge

value.links: bridgeheads that are part of the main ring or main bridge
bridgeheads where at least one is part of a secondary bridge

value.ring_count: the minimum number of scissions required to convert the system into an acyclic skeleton

value.procedure: apply the following rules in order until a decision is reached

value.base_name: the acyclic hydrocarbon having the same total number of skeletal atoms

value.numbers: skeletal atoms in each of the two segments connecting the main bridgeheads and in the main bridge

value.completion: number the main bridge beginning with the atom next to the first bridgehead
value.first_path: the longer segment of the main ring to the second bridgehead
value.return_path: the unnumbered segment of the main ring back to the first bridgehead

value.condition: a polycyclic ring system has more than one bridge connecting atoms of the main ring and/or the main bridge

value.definition: a bridge other than the main bridge

value.basis: a bicyclic system described in P-23.2.2

independent_secondary_bridge.attachment_locants: a pair of superscript arabic numbers, lower first and separated by a comma
independent_secondary_bridge.length: number of atoms, expressed as an arabic number

parts.meaning: three rings in the polyalicyclic system

order: two branches of the main ring
parts.punctuation: all separated by full stops and placed in brackets
parts.secondary_bridge_locants: superscript locants separated by commas indicating points of attachment to the main ring

parts.value: the acyclic hydrocarbon having the same total number of skeletal atoms

value.precondition: the main ring and main bridge have been numbered
value.start: the higher numbered bridgehead of the main ring

value.application_inheritance: follow the naming and numbering rules for bicyclic systems described in P-23.2.1 through P-23.2.4

value.reason: polycyclic systems require an additional selection rule

value.attachment_locants: cite the two attachment-point locants as a pair of superscript arabic numbers, lower first, separated by a comma
value.independent_bridge_order: cite numbers for independent secondary bridges in decreasing order
value.secondary_bridge_lengths: cite the number of atoms in each secondary bridge as an arabic number

value.indicates: number of rings in the polyalicyclic system
value.ring_count: number of bond cuts needed to transform the system into an acyclic skeleton, whether unbranched or branched

value.attachment_locants: locants from the already numbered bicyclic structure, separated by a comma
value.position: after the numbers describing the bicyclic system
value.secondary_bridge_lengths: arabic numbers separated by full stops
value.superscript_binding: each attachment-locant pair is superscripted to the arabic number denoting that bridge's length
